name: bagos
description: Every AI-initiated Solana spend: gated, capped, confirmed on chain.
long_description: MCP server for Bags on Solana. Read tools cover token analytics, creator-fee rosters, claim audit trails and trade quotes. The two write tools execute swaps and claim creator fees, but the first call to either signs nothing: it returns a preview and a single-use confirmation token fingerprinted to the exact arguments, so a token issued for a 0.01 SOL swap cannot authorize a 10 SOL one. Every write passes a token gate, a hard SOL spend cap per transaction and per session, and a simulation, before it is signed and submitted. Writes are off unless a keypair is configured and are mainnet-only; the server defaults to devnet so an unconfigured install cannot spend real money.

bags_api_key.title: Bags API key
bags_api_key.description: Needed before any tool can return data — every call fails without it. Left optional so the server installs and lists its tools first, and you can add the key once you have one. Create one at https://dev.bags.fm under API Keys.

bags_network.title: Solana cluster
bags_network.description: devnet or mainnet. Bags has no devnet deployment, so trading and fee claims require mainnet — but devnet is the default so an unconfigured install cannot spend real money.

bags_keypair_path.title: Solana keypair file
bags_keypair_path.description: Only needed for trading and fee claims. Leave empty to run read-only. Create one with: solana-keygen new -o ~/.config/bags/keypair.json

bags_max_sol_per_tx.title: Max SOL per transaction
bags_max_sol_per_tx.description: Hard cap on what any single transaction may spend. A write exceeding this is refused before signing.

bags_max_sol_per_session.title: Max SOL per session
bags_max_sol_per_session.description: Hard cap on total SOL spent across one server session. Resets when the server restarts.

bos_token_mint.title: Gate token mint
bos_token_mint.description: Mint address of the token that gates the write tools. Without it, write tools fail their gate check.

bos_required_balance.title: Gate token balance required
bos_required_balance.description: Minimum balance of the gate token needed to call a write tool.

tools.name: bags_authenticate
tools.description: Authenticate with Bags API utilizing the V2 signature challenge flow. Automatically loads local wallet.

tools.name: bags_claim_fees
tools.description: GATED WRITE: Claim pending creator/LP fees for the given token mints. Requires $BOS. Two-step: the first call previews and returns a confirmation token; call again with it to sign and submit. Returns confirmed on-chain signatures.

tools.name: bags_execute_trade
tools.description: GATED WRITE: Swap tokens on Bags pools. Requires $BOS. Two-step: the first call returns a preview and a confirmation token; call again with that token to sign and submit. Returns a confirmed on-chain signature. SOL mint: So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112.

tools.name: bags_get_claimable_fees
tools.description: Query all claimable creator/LP fees for a wallet. Free read-only tier.

tools.name: bags_get_creators
tools.description: Query top creators by lifetime fees on Bags. Free read-only tier.

tools.name: bags_get_partner_stats
tools.description: View partner referral earnings for the configured wallet. Free read-only tier.

tools.name: bags_get_token_analytics
tools.description: Get pool info, claim stats, and bonding curve progress for a token. Free read-only tier.

tools.name: bags_get_token_claim_events
tools.description: Get the fee-claim audit trail for a token: who claimed, how much, when, and the transaction signature. Paginated via limit/offset. Free read-only tier.

tools.name: bags_get_token_claim_stats
tools.description: Get per-creator claim totals for a token: each fee-share creator with their royalty split and total claimed amount. Free read-only tier.

tools.name: bags_get_token_creators
tools.description: Get the royalty split for a token: every creator sharing its fees, their wallet, social provider, and share in basis points. Free read-only tier.

tools.name: bags_get_trade_quote
tools.description: Get a swap quote to trade SOL and any Bags ecosystem token. Free read-only tier. SOL mint: So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112. Default BOS token mint: EkJuyYyD3to61CHVPJn6wHb7xANxvqApnVJ4o2SdBAGS.

tools.name: bags_heartbeat
tools.description: Periodic health check combining basic node status with an earnings/balance summary. Free read-only tier.

tools.name: bags_prepare_token_metadata
tools.description: GATED: Create token info and metadata on Bags, returning the reserved mint address and metadata URL. Requires $BOS. This PREPARES a launch — it does not launch the token and does not send an on-chain transaction.

tools.name: bags_resolve_launch_wallet
tools.description: Resolve a social handle (twitter, tiktok, kick, or github) to its Bags fee-share launch wallet. Free read-only tier.
